findings: ASG11: for positive g,m, the clearing integer can be chosen with support away from g and converts exactly the local completed-lattice conditions into the original InAt. InMod residue comparison is now explicitly restricted to integral vectors and integral supplied generators. This is the scope used by every later application.

ASG12: split dual lattices yield the actual reference frame, including ew idempotence/orthogonality/fullness, beta-duality, all cross-pairing congruences and full latticeSpan. The last complementary pair is recovered by ew*z0 and conjugate(ew)*z0. All choices are finite adeles; the generic g=1 and k=0 branches are covered.

ASG13: the arbitrary supplied reference frame is used, not replaced by the constructed one. Its projection to the exact hyperbolic complement has the same residue. Transitivity on unimodular vector/covector pairs over the local Artinian residue ring and invertible matrix lifting give the required local unitary operators; identity elsewhere proves the exact OneOff and Kset fields. The single reference frame is retained for every word.

ASG14: the unitriangular residue shape gives additivity of the exact chi2f coordinate, including the final e-to-z link and conjugate orientation. The Haar-normalized eOf has the original conjugation sign, all positive-type finite sums, both Kg invariances, support/unipotence and convolution clauses. Positive-type grouping uses right K2 cosets and produces the displayed nonnegative modulus square.

ASG15: the actual DC large-gap models and normalized vectors satisfy literal IsDS/IsLowUnit; IsLowUnit requires only membership in the original lowKSub and unit norm. Finite Hilbert tensor and scalar weak integration supply every original bundle field with the same Haar measure and fundamental domain. Unweighted coefficient integrability is sufficient for this endpoint, without assuming the distinct weighted local estimate.

ASG16: the corrected compact highest weight is alpha_i=nu_i-(k-1)/2+i, precisely lowK(allPos,nu). Original even k and half-integral u give integrality; the original integral interlacing parameter gives dominance. DC1 therefore supplies exact IsHCTypeU at the original parameter. The quotient S/N, action on the positive complement, original matW pairings and all three tensor fields agree with source definitions.

ASG17: the exact source N is the kernel of the positive-complement quotient and is upper unitriangular in an adapted basis; H is compact and S=N semidirect H. Nilpotence/real unipotence and the compact action modulus prove the product Haar is also right invariant. Quotient Haar and a Borel section yield the literal ambient-measure Weil formula for all nonnegative measurable functions, without rescaling the supplied infinity measure.

ASG18: the dependent choices A,L,P,Rf,Xu,Bu,Pi,Mu remain on the same original objects and all words are chosen after the common frame. RFD8 supplies only RowsFinDim for this actual bundle. Remaining W/measured-field/Siegel-Weil/spectral/counting inputs are correctly excluded.
